errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is labeled "Години" (Years), but the categories displayed on the axis are the specific years 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021. The description incorrectly interprets the axis label as the name for the categories.
The description lists the approximate values for each year but omits pointing out that 2017 has the highest value and 2018 has the lowest value, which are key features of the data distribution.
